title: ResourceMonitorService
responsibility: Refreshes telemetry, heartbeats running work and waits for admission while checking cancellation and parent lifetime.

inputs.name: ResourceMonitorService.constructor.options
inputs.description: Requires the resource home path and queue repository; the adapter is optional. If adapter is omitted, the constructor uses `new HostResourcesAdapter()`.

inputs.name: ResourceMonitorService.heartbeat.id
inputs.description: UUID of the resource queue job to patch; the method refreshes `heartbeatAt` and stores its current pressure notice.

inputs.name: ResourceMonitorService.wait.id
inputs.description: UUID of the queued resource job to schedule; the method returns only after the job is marked running.

inputs.name: ResourceMonitorService.wait.request
inputs.description: Carries priority, CPU cores, memory in MiB and the public label used by scheduling. Requests that exceed usable capacity after reserves are rejected as impossible.

inputs.name: ResourceMonitorService.wait.options
inputs.description: Controls cancellation, the wait deadline and notification when a new queue notice appears. `waitTimeoutMs` defaults to `1800000` when omitted, and `env` is not read by this method.

outputs.name: ResourceMonitorService.snapshot
outputs.description: Returns the cached queue snapshot while its age is nonnegative and below the configured poll interval; otherwise it samples the adapter and saves that snapshot.

outputs.name: ResourceMonitorService.heartbeat
outputs.description: Updates the job heartbeat timestamp and its pressure notice. Snapshot failures are caught and recorded as a hold notice so the running work can continue.

outputs.name: ResourceMonitorService.sweep
outputs.description: Checks at most once every 5000 ms and scans only when a job heartbeat is older than 30000 ms. It removes only IDs returned by `abandonedResources` when `processTable()` has rows.

outputs.name: ResourceMonitorService.wait
outputs.description: Resolves when scheduling marks the target job running, polling and sweeping while it waits. Cancellation, timeout, impossible capacity, a missing job or an ended parent prevents admission.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: `wait` throws `Error` when its deadline passes, the request exceeds usable capacity after reserves, the queued job disappears, or its parent is no longer running. An aborted signal rejects with the signal’s abort reason.
